items.item_text: Associate degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience which provides the following knowledge, skills and abilities listed under "Special Skills" may be considered
At least two (2) years of experience performing related duties with at least one (1) year working in a healthcare setting

Special Skills: Knowledge: Demonstrable knowledge and experience with Health Insurance, Medical Groups, Billing and Medical Terminology. Solid understanding of business communications and relationships between Hospitalists with departments internal to the hospital such as HIM, Patient Registration, Emergency, Inpatient Units and external entities such as the transfer center, pharmacies, funeral homes, county health department. Applies sound critical thinking skills partnered with strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities. Verifiable experience of working independently with little supervision. Demonstrated, Verifiable Skills: Established expertise in business office procedures, correspondence and filing systems. Proven ability to apply good judgment in a variety of confidential and sensitive situations while handling multiple, detail-oriented, time-sensitive assignments. Plan and organize work making effective use of time and ensuring state-mandated deadlines are met. Proven ability to remain calm and flexible, while prioritizing, organizing and completing tasks in a busy sometimes chaotic work environment. Maintain extensive record-keeping systems and provide evidence of attention to detail. Evaluate situations accurately and take appropriate and effective action independent of direct oversight. Perform business and statistical mathematics to include arithmetic calculations. Reconcile reports and prepare adjustments. Prepare and type memos and correspondence, using correct spelling, grammar, punctuation and proper business format. Communicate effectively by telephone, in person and/or writing detailed program information as necessitated to physicians, leadership, coworkers and appropriate others. Able to work in a manner in order to establish and maintain cooperative and effective working relationships. Maintain the confidentiality of patient/employee information. Demonstrated computer and proficient typing skills. Verifiable experience with Windows-based PCs, word processing and database applications. Knowledge and proficiency in Google Workspace programs, Video teleconferencing applications, Cerner/Care Connect, MS4 and Billing software. Ability to prepare a variety of reports collating both manual and computer information. Demonstrated ability and experience with accurate data entry, sorting and filtering.
Four (4) or more years experience performing related duties in a healthcare or acute care setting preferred
Prior training and experience working in a Hospitalist/Hospital Medicine Dept highly desired
Accurately and consistently provides oversight for and prepares Hospitalist census reports through daily tracking and coordination of patient flow within the Hospitalist Program including "hot lists"
Oversees the completion and reconciliation of the E-billing system and works with the Business Office to assure timely completion
Provides central coordination of patient admissions and assignments to physicians

Prepares and develops logs, records, schedules, files and manuals; prepares and/or types a variety of reports, charts, graphs and other materials, utilizing both manual and computer generated data with accuracy 95% of the time.
Facilitates patient/physician identification and tracking, as well as education, when needed, as measured through feedback from physicians and managers
Acts as liaison between the Hospitalist Program, Hospital, Medical Groups and Health Plans.
